pipeline.archived_notice: This book is archived and read-only. Restore it to run or restart steps.
pipeline.restart_about: Moves the book back to this step. Files stay; when you run a step again you choose to replace or keep its output.
pipeline.restart_confirm: Move this book back to “{step}”? Later steps will need to be run again.
pipeline.running_hint: You can leave this page; the run continues on the server. Progress is in the server log.
pipeline.result_kept: Kept the existing output and moved on
pipeline.not_runnable_archived: This book is archived, so nothing runs here.
pipeline.not_runnable_done: This step is done. Restart from it to run it again.
pipeline.not_runnable_later: Reach this step first; the steps before it are not done yet.
pipeline.not_runnable_current: This step cannot run from the WebUI yet.
pipeline.tui_note: This step needs a decision the WebUI cannot take yet. Continue it in the TUI:
pipeline.queue_note: Audio is made by the synthesis queue. Queue chapters with the task wizard, then run the batch runner:
pipeline.refused_not_found: This book is not in the repo any more. It may have been deleted from another window.
pipeline.refused_archived: This book is archived and read-only. Restore it first.
pipeline.refused_not_current: Only the current step can run. Restart from this step first.
pipeline.refused_needs_decision: This step needs a decision the WebUI cannot take yet. Use the TUI.
pipeline.already_running: A step is already running for this book. Wait for it to finish.
pipeline.restart_refused: You can only restart from a step the book has already reached.
pipeline.ch_empty: No chapters yet. They appear after “Clean text”.
pipeline.about.bootstrap: Reads the EPUB’s title, author, language and cover, and extracts its images into the book folder.
pipeline.about.transcript_extract: Copies every file of the EPUB spine to raw/ and writes raw/0_toc.md, which lists what the table of contents covers.
pipeline.about.transcript_merge: Builds one HTML file per chapter in merged/ (merge mode detected automatically) and writes merged/0_toc.md. Before cleaning, set excluded=y in that file for chapters to leave out.
pipeline.about.transcript_clean: Applies the book’s cleaning rules to the merged chapters and writes cleaned/. Chapters marked excluded=y in merged/0_toc.md are skipped.
pipeline.about.transcript_text: Turns the cleaned chapters into plain text (raw/) and the TTS script (tts_script/) under transcript_text/.
pipeline.about.transcript_review: You read and fix the transcripts, normalize them with the language skill, and choose which format feeds synthesis.
pipeline.about.tts_config: Choose the engine, model and narrator voice (and role voices) for this book.
pipeline.about.synthesis: Generates the audio sentence by sentence and merges it into chapter files.
pipeline.about.combine: Joins the chapter audio into the finished audiobook with its metadata and cover.
pipeline.merge_numbering_reset: Chapter numbers restart in each volume
pipeline.merge_reset_label: Restart chapter numbers in each volume
pipeline.merge_applies_next: Changes apply the next time chapters are merged (restart from Merge chapters).
pipeline.sel_orphans: {n} orphan files are always left out
pipeline.clean_none_over: None over the {pct} % threshold. Highest first.
pipeline.clean_no_results: No results yet. They appear after the text is cleaned.
pipeline.text_not_saved: Not saved: chosen on every run, as in the TUI.
pipeline.review_no_text: No transcripts yet. Run “Make transcripts” first.
pipeline.review_pick: Choose a chapter to read it.
pipeline.review_readonly: Read-only. Fix text in VS Code or with the normalization skill:
pipeline.notice_stale: Saved. “{step}” must run again for this to take effect.
pipeline.refused_bad_options: Those options are not valid for this step. Choose at least one format and use one of them for synthesis.
pipeline.decision_not_found: This book is not in the repo any more.
pipeline.decision_not_merged: Chapters can be chosen after “Merge chapters” has run.
pipeline.decision_unknown_chapter: That chapter is not in merged/0_toc.md. Reload the page.
pipeline.decision_unknown_rule: Unknown cleaning rule. Reload the page.
pipeline.decision_unknown_file: That transcript file does not exist. Run “Make transcripts” again.
pipeline.tts_no_voices: Voice rows appear once the book reaches this step.
pipeline.tts_no_refs: No reference voices for “{language}”. Import some with tools/tts_import_voice.py.
pipeline.tts_save_continue: Save and continue to Synthesize audio
pipeline.tts_lock_note: Saving takes the job lock; it is refused while a batch synthesizes this book.
pipeline.tts_not_found: This book is not in the repo any more.
pipeline.tts_unknown_voice: A voice row no longer belongs to this book. Reload the page.
pipeline.tts_unknown_reference: That reference voice no longer exists. Reload the page.
pipeline.tts_missing_file: The voice file is missing on disk: {detail}
pipeline.meta_language_note: The language picks the text rules and the voice library. Changing it takes the job lock and is refused while a batch synthesizes this book.
pipeline.meta_no_images: No images yet. Add some below.
pipeline.meta_import_note: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP or BMP, up to 20 MB each. Added images join the gallery; choose one and save.
pipeline.meta_import_not_image: not an image (JPEG / PNG / GIF / WebP / BMP)
pipeline.meta_import_bad_url: only http(s) URLs can be downloaded
pipeline.meta_bad_cover: That cover is not one of this book's images. Reload the page.
pipeline.meta_nothing_to_import: Choose image files or enter at least one URL.
